scientific_integrity: The two explicit selector integers, full bounded verification programs, and a mathematical lower-bound proof are included. No result depends on unspecified solver state or extrapolating experiments.
scientific_limitations: The equalities cover exactly the directed binary incoming-ball cases (n,t)=(7,4) and (9,5), not all boundary radii, larger alphabets, outgoing balls, or sensor failures. Historical priority is only best-knowledge from inspected sources; external independent review remains outstanding.
title: Sharp boundary identification in two binary de Bruijn digraphs
